## What to build

For each test result, the buck2 event log lets a tool tell whether it was a hit, whether it came from a local or remote store, and its original duration (spec §2).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A tool reading `buck2 log show` can distinguish hits from fresh runs per test
- [ ] Local vs remote origin and the original duration are recoverable from the log
- [ ] No new report format is added
